app.name: AVE Probe
app.short_description: Reads and writes the AV encoder's I2C registers
app.long_description: Shows a test pattern with a machine-readable step code, tries reading back the AVE's registers over I2C, and steps through AVE register writes given in sd:/apps/aveprobe/wtb.txt (or by the Wii test bench), holding each so a capture can see its effect. AVE settings reset on power-off.
